questions.question: How much have you used AI coding agents like this one?
Which AI apps and agent harnesses have you used?
Which Cloudflare products have you used before?
Where have you deployed apps before? (pick any)
What are you interested in building on Cloudflare?
What do you want to build or learn?
questions.hint: Tell us about your idea, who it is for, and what you hope to learn. More context helps your agent connect the course to what you want to build.

questions.question: How do you like to learn?
questions.hint: For example: explain each step, let me try first, use diagrams, or compare with tools I know. More context helps your agent tailor the pace and explanations.

questions.question: Want a short quiz at the end of each exercise? (recommended, skippable anytime)
